activity_summary: Bartholomew showed you the ewes and the first pink-tipped buds, put a cup on the sill, and went back to the pen. Anne would not let you make a host of him. You took the cup.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the basket, took the cup, and let Bartholomew go.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped the visit from becoming a hosting.

entities.name: Bartholomew Hathaway
entities.context: Showed the ewes and the buds, gave the cup, and returned to the pen.

facets.activity: Took the cup and let Bartholomew go back to the pen

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Take the cup, Will, and do not make him a host.
